title: P1 card.details: response
description: Card details from a code template: the template name and the closed fields of the subject record; model text only in the untrusted_text field, which the channel shows in the untrusted text wrapper. If the mark is above the group chat ceiling, deliver_to: direct, and the channel sends the details in a direct chat to the person who pressed (APR-11, APR-14).

template.description: Code template from the text catalog.

fields.description: Closed fields of the subject record for the template.

untrusted_text.description: Model text, if the template shows it; only in the untrusted text wrapper.
